thresholdSelection: Chosen from speed/agreement probe on 329 sampled states (seeds 17010001-17010040, disjoint from game seeds) before any game outcome was observed.
endpoint: Normal opening to first 1536 or real death; 6000-move guard raises an error and never counts as failure.
primary: B minus A success rate; paired 95% CI (normal approx. on paired differences) and exact two-sided McNemar.
secondary: C minus A, D minus A, D minus B; CPU ms per move (mean, p95, max). Reported as exploratory.
stopping: Fixed 1024 pairs per arm; no extension or early stop based on outcomes.
comparison: Reference exact-4 results from V7 (97.66%, 512 different seeds) are context only, not a paired arm.
scope: No training, same frozen leaf model. Native C++ timing only; browser timing measured separately in JS.
